# harness_platform_sso_ldap (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving the account-level LDAP SSO settings via the NextGen LDAP APIs. Requires the `PL_ENABLE_NG_LDAP_SETTINGS` feature flag to be enabled on the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the account-level LDAP SSO configuration of a Harness account.
# Exactly one LDAP configuration exists per account, so no arguments are needed.
data "harness_platform_sso_ldap" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `connection_settings` (List of Object) LDAP connection settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_settings))
- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression for periodic synchronization of user groups from the LDAP directory.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the LDAP SSO configuration is disabled.
- `group_settings` (List of Object) LDAP group query settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_settings))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `identifier` (String) Identifier of the LDAP SSO configuration.
- `name` (String) Name of the LDAP SSO configuration.
- `url` (String) URL of the LDAP server.
- `user_settings` (List of Object) LDAP user query settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_settings))
